_comments.purpose: Extract complete rows when Proxy Destination URL is not empty.
_comments.paths: Relative paths are resolved from the directory containing this config.json file. Absolute paths are also supported on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
_comments.row_numbers: header_row identifies the field-name row. data_start_row identifies the first row eligible for extraction.
_comments.row_conditions: Add one object for each row condition. Use condition_mode all for AND logic or any for OR logic.
_comments.output_columns: Use an empty list to export every column, or list header names, Excel letters, or one-based column numbers.
_comments.preserve_format_columns: Copy source cell formatting for every extracted cell in the listed columns, including wrapped text.
_comments.preserve_format_values: Copy source cell formatting when a configured column contains one of the configured values.
_comments.operators: Supported operators: not_empty, empty, equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, regex.
